title: Zuriel Connected Scripture Trails — Batch 1
description: Curated thematic pathways linking passages across the biblical canon. Each trail includes ordered references, connection prompts, study questions, and an editorial caution against proof-texting.
editorialPrinciples: References are study directions, not substitutes for reading each passage in context.
Connections may be thematic, typological, prophetic, or explicitly quoted; they do not all have the same strength.
Read surrounding chapters and compare translations where available.
Do not assume connected passages have identical audiences, covenants, or historical settings.

trails.overview: Trace creation, human rebellion, renewal in Christ, and the promised renewal of all things.

What words, images, promises, or themes connect these passages?
